# UX Checklist: Base de dados (data-base)

**Purpose**: Validar a qualidade dos requisitos de interface da 004 (aba "Stats" simples com os 10 números, estados sem número, nada a preencher) antes do plano
**Created**: 2026-11-09
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

Depth: Standard · Audience: Reviewer (PR)

## A aba

- [x] CHK001 Are the tab's name and place in the window specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017]
- [x] CHK002 Are the 10 numbers listed by name? [Completeness, Spec §FR-017]
- [x] CHK003 Is the absence of fields to fill in stated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-020]
- [x] CHK004 Is the format of each number defined? [Gap, Spec §Open Questions]
- [x] CHK005 Is the rounding of the displayed numbers specified against the game's? [Clarity, Spec §FR-018, §SC-001]

## Estados sem número

- [x] CHK006 Is the text before the first calculation specified, and that numbers then update in place? [Clarity, Spec §FR-024]
- [x] CHK007 Is the text defined for no new reading (character select, released reader, reading switched off)? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, §Open Questions]
- [x] CHK008 Are "Calculator unavailable" for the whole tab and "unavailable" for one number distinguished? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014, §FR-015]
- [x] CHK009 Is the behavior of a failed calculation defined for the rest of the app? [Coverage, Spec §FR-014, §US3]

## Outros personagens

- [x] CHK010 Is the display for a character of another class specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-019, §US4]
- [x] CHK011 Is it stated that numbers from two characters never mix after a change of character? [Consistency, Spec §FR-022, §US1]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- CHK004: fica para o plano (Open Questions, `to plan`).
